summary: The clinic's holidays and exception schedules.
purpose: Days when the clinic is closed or opens with different hours. The calendar and the portal don't offer appointments on those days.
tips: Enter the year's holidays as soon as it starts to avoid bookings by mistake.

config.holidays.field.date.label: Date
config.holidays.field.date.description: The day of the holiday or closure.

config.holidays.field.dates.label: Dates
config.holidays.field.dates.description: For a one-off exception, you can mark several days.

config.holidays.field.sede_id.label: Branch
config.holidays.field.sede_id.description: Leave «All branches» to apply it to the whole clinic.

config.holidays.field.is_open.label: Is it open?
config.holidays.field.is_open.description: Open with different hours, or closed.

config.holidays.field.start_time.label: From
config.holidays.field.start_time.description: Leave both times empty to close all day; with a range only that stretch is closed.
